notes: Probing: 'nieces and nephews' 0.66 (on ' neph'), 'his great-granddaughter' 0.30, 'children and grandchildren' 0.24; 'his daughter' 0.06, 'his secretary' 0.06, but 'her son and his wife' 0.28 on ' and', so a coordinated kin list alone leaks.
